run_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint using --fine-tune-checkpoint and --output-release-checkpoint
run_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_with_ya: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and its YAML config to release format using --fine-tune-yaml and --output-release-yaml
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_function: call convert_fine_tune_checkpoint to merge backbone and heads config from a starting checkpoint into a fine-tuned checkpoint
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint_data_only: call convert_fine_tune_checkpoint for data-only fine-tuning where heads config is copied from the starting checkpoint
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to understand how it removes finetune_config and merges backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
